reviews_data.review_text:
Tucked right off the rail trail in a great part of downtown Charlotte, this shop is both aesthetic and peaceful.
It’s a quiet spot — great for studying — though seating is very limited. If you’re meeting someone, hope the cushioned chairs are open, or plan to head outside. The only real indoor study option was a barstool at the window with no chair back (which I personally wouldn’t mind).

Prices were a bit on the high side, but that seems to be the norm in Charlotte. That said, the cappuccino I ordered was one of the better ones I’ve had — smooth, balanced, and delicious. I get the sense that anything on their menu would’ve been equally solid.

Bonus points for offering unique, small-batch beans for sale and a free water station. I’d definitely stop by again.

reviews_data.review_text: Very aesthetic and new coffee shop. Super clean and the staff is friendly. It’s on the smaller side - there are a few barstools where you can try to get some work done, but it’s probably not the best spot for that. More of a grab-and-go type of place. I got the iced cortado and it was solid.

So excited that they opened another Night Swim! I’ve loved going to the one in LoSo, but it was definitely less convenient for me.

Same vibes as the LoSo location, just a bit smaller and less seating, so definitely more of a grab and go situation.

They were able to make my coffee quickly, and it was just as great as the rest of their locations!
